items.a: A conversation about the problem, not the feature list — then a written statement, success criteria and fixed scope before any code.

items.q: How long does a build take?
items.a: A focused project usually ships in weeks, not quarters. You get a fixed timeline with the written statement — and a build that actually hits it.
Fixed scope, fixed price — quoted after we agree on the written statement. No hourly billing, no surprise invoices.
